newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Southcoast cuts VLSI.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Southcoast cuts VLSI.

text.p: -- Southcoast Capital analyst Ashok Kumar said he cut his 1997 earnings estimate on VLSI Technology Inc to $1.15 per share from $1.42 per share previously.
-- He left unchanged his near- and long-term buy ratings on the stock.

-- He said the stock had been subject to an "extreme overreaction" on Friday. "Lack of a positive earnings surprise coupled with a flat top line sequential guidance drove the momentum players out of the stock," he commented.
-- Kumar said a conservative valutation would be 1.5 times 1997 sales or $26 per share.
